source_snapshot.procedure: Clear RAS EEPROM devices 0..7, reset, load amdgpu ras_enable=1, inject device 0 GFX block 2 type 8, compare retired bad-page addresses before/after one AC cycle, and correlate OOB Redfish plus in-band CPER.
source_snapshot.criteria: Injection returns Bus error; CPER index increases; decoded evidence matches OAM plus UMC ext0 On-die ECC Deferred and GC ext62 GfxGcError Uncorrected poison; exact bad-page list persists across AC; in-band CPER matches.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; compresses the destructive chain and does not resolve mixed CPER semantics or secure evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; requires AMD/FAE scenario, baseline export, secure CPER and explicit UMC/GC record model.

old_problem: One GFX block-2/type-8 injection is expected to yield both UMC ext0/On-die-ECC/Deferred and GC ext62/GfxGcError/Uncorrected-poison semantics, but the source does not state whether these are two correlated records, one compound record or copied criteria. It also clears eight EEPROM targets before proving scope, uses insecure hardcoded Redfish/transfer examples and leaves enumeration identity and AC recovery unspecified.
disposition_reason: Retain Pending and Source Conflict under ED-16/17/18/19/28/30. AMD public documentation confirms address-bearing retired-page and CPER capabilities but does not define this proprietary amdgpuras injection's exact UMC/GC record cardinality, code/severity mapping, EEPROM-clear scope or restoration. These are core command/expected-result/recovery semantics, not ordinary runtime parameters. Guessing them could erase RAS history, poison/retire memory, misattribute CPER or leave the platform unavailable after AC. A gate-closed one-shot draft preserves full coverage and exact unlock evidence.
decision_basis: XLSX row 1976, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, ED-01 through ED-30 and AMD RAS/bad-page/CPER documentation were read; validator reconciliation showed the adjacent adopted range was already reviewed, and the actual first-missing queue row was directly opened as Functionality 2011 / Wistron-BMC-01032-V002 / 92add9ca4b948888.
AMD SMI documents retired-page addresses and CPER retrieval, so exact address-set persistence and OOB/in-band artifact correlation are technically valid evidence goals.
AMD release notes document version-dependent bad-page EEPROM recovery and prior in-band/OOB CPER inconsistency, making exact driver/tool/firmware compatibility essential rather than inferable.
No public authority found defines how this device0/block2/type8 injection must produce the source's simultaneous UMC and GC field sets; only AMD/FAE can approve cardinality and causal mapping.
EEPROM clear, driver lifecycle, injection and true AC removal are destructive/stateful operations requiring baseline export, exact device identity, one-shot authorization and independent recovery.
No EEPROM/log clear, reset, driver load, injection, bad-page/CPER access, Redfish, transfer, AC cycle, recovery, retry or DUT action was performed.
